assertion_analysis.failure_condition: A sheet row carrying an unexpected or leaking key makes sheet_leaks return a finding and check_sheet return 1; the planted arm row is refused in sheet-check.log at the head.
A row whose source_path is blank makes sheet_blank_paths return a finding; sheet-check-mutated.log shows row-075 refused at EXIT=1.

assertion_analysis.failure_condition:: A corpus critique that differs from the stored run raises, so a retry prompt that had drifted stops the pass rather than being measured.

reuse.reason: the comparison needs the refine call without the bench's judge; a no-judge mode in run_refine_bench is a product change outside this evidence-fenced node

findings.text: blocking: the arm key for every new sheet row is built as {arm: [case_id] for arm in ARMS}, so all 82 rows of srtj-refine-ab-key.json name both arms as producers although only 2 identical output pairs were produced by both; the scoring node that reads this key after labelling cannot attribute a label to an arm, so the A/B cannot be scored from it.

blocking: arms[arm]["outputs"] is the count of the in-process ok receipts (118 and 116, i.e. 240 minus the 6 errors) and so counts the 20 answers that returned an empty refined name as outputs, while srtj-refine-ab-run.html:54-61 states an empty answer is not an output; arms[arm]["failures"] reports only the model-side errors, so the manifest's "counted as a failure throughout" is untrue of the delivered results JSON.

follow-on: the committed results JSON was not produced by the committed script - it omits the top-level retried_keys the script emits at line 875 and its retried_note and per-arm key order differ from the script's (JSON written 14:31, script last edited 14:38), so a reader cannot tell which logic produced the delivered numbers.

follow-on: check_sheet proves it refuses a leaked field and a blank source path but has no case for a row whose refined_name is empty, so the rule the head commit added - that an answer without a name never reaches the sheet - is the one sheet rule with no guard.

follow-on: run_arms repeats the refine rendering and structured call owned by imas_codex/standard_names/benchmark_roles.py:616 run_refine_bench, so a change to that call path must be made twice; the node is fenced to evidence paths and cannot extend the owner.
